listed_quote.quote: shareholders of BlackRock Strategic Equity Dividend Trust (NYSE:BDT) held today, shareholders of BDT have approved the reorganization of BDT with and into BlackRock Enhanced Equity Dividend Trust (NYSE:BDJ)

announcement.quote: shareholders of BDT have approved the reorganization of BDT with and into BlackRock Enhanced Equity Dividend Trust (NYSE:BDJ) (the “BDT Reorganization”).

deals.notes: Earliest filing in the window is the N-14 8C of 2011-10-05 (0000891092-11-006766), whose shown excerpts list BDV, BDT and BDJ and describe reorganization agreements but do not themselves name this pair in a quotable sentence; the 2011-12-22 425 is the earliest excerpt that names the BDT reorganization. BDT shareholders approved on 2011-12-22. The same 425 says the BDT and BDV reorganizations are not contingent on each other. No excerpt states that the BDT merger closed.

listed_quote.quote: (NYSE:BDJ) (the “BDT Reorganization”). Special meetings of shareholders of BlackRock Equity Dividend Trust (NYSE:BDV)

announcement.quote: the proposed reorganization of BDV with and into BDJ (with respect to BDV shareholders) (the “BDV Reorganization” and, together with the BDT Reorganization, the “Reorganizations”)

deals.notes: On 2011-12-22 the BDV and BDJ special meetings were adjourned to January 26, 2012 to solicit more votes; BDV proxy reminders of 2012-01-06 say the meeting was adjourned until January 26, 2012. The 425s filed 2012-01-13 and 2012-01-27 are shown only by their first lines, so no result of the January 26 meeting is in front of me. The 2012 and 2013 DEF 14As shown are fund-wide annual-meeting proxies with no merger result.

problems: Neither deal's outcome is stated in any excerpt; the January 2012 filings that may carry the result are shown only as headers.
